svg.title: Rosé Pine Moon terminal with Cosipa's Fish and Starship prompt
svg.desc: Terminal styling recreation, not a screenshot. IosevkaTerm Nerd Font Mono, the font installed for Kitty and Foot, rendered as outlines so the appearance does not depend on viewer fonts. Rosé Pine Moon background, two-line Starship prompt, no title bar, no window buttons, and a steady beam cursor.
